job.job_description:
Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced AI/ML Engineer with strong hands-on expertise in Python, Pandas, Machine Learning, and AI to develop and deploy data-driven solutions.


Location

Noida, Uttar Pradesh, India


Job Type

Full time


Job Opening Name

AI Engineer


Experience

78 Years


Responsibilities

Develop and implement ML/AI models for business requirements.
Analyze large datasets and identify trends and insights.
Build and maintain ML pipelines and workflows.
Collaborate with data engineers and cross-functional teams.
Work with deep learning frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, or Keras.
Support AI/ML model integration and production deployment.
Stay updated with emerging AI/ML technologies.


Requirements

78 years of experience in AI/ML/Data Science.
Strong Python, Pandas, Machine Learning, and Statistics skills.
Experience with Data Analysis Visualization.
Hands-on experience with TensorFlow/PyTorch/Keras.
Experience handling large datasets and databases.
Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or related field.
Strong communication and problem-solving skills.


Preferred

Working knowledge of MERN Stack (MongoDB, Express.js, React, Node.js).
Experience integrating AI/ML models into production applications.


Disclaimer: This job posting has been aggregated from external source. Role details, content, and availability are subject to change. Applicants are advised to confirm the latest information directly on the company website before applying.
